method: Independent full-prose inspection of all three frozen drafts against the frozen Guardian source. Gold is NOT defined as whatever the auditor previously flagged. SOURCE-FIDELITY question only: 'is this proposition supported by the frozen commissioned evidence?' -- never 'could it be true in the world?'

unsupported_findings.source_anchor: She appears throughout her show at City Art Gallery in self-portraits
unsupported_findings.why: Source names the venue City Art Gallery; the article itself uses that correct name in P4, then mutates it in P7. Invented variant + internal inconsistency.

unsupported_findings.span: it is happening to a person who did not know the work existed an hour ago
unsupported_findings.source_anchor: some subcultural genius or longlost creative you've never heard of
unsupported_findings.why: Source supports visitor unfamiliarity but establishes no timeline. 'an hour ago' is invented duration; the asserted knowledge-state is stated as settled fact.
unsupported_findings.min_correction: Remove the invented interval; keep only source-supported unfamiliarity.

unsupported_findings.span: It is a two-sided obligation, and the second side is the one that presses.
unsupported_findings.source_anchor: a duty - to viewers and to their subjects - to tell them clearly
unsupported_findings.why: Source names two directions but says nothing about their relative weight. A comparative judgement stated declaratively as though the review established it.
unsupported_findings.min_correction: Mark the comparison as the article's own reading.

unsupported_findings.span: without the visitor having brought anything to the encounter except the willingness to walk in
unsupported_findings.source_anchor: some subcultural genius or longlost creative you've never heard of
unsupported_findings.why: Asserts visitors' preparation and mental state generally. Not having heard of an artist is not 'having brought nothing'.

unsupported_findings.span: taken here not because the review places them above the rest but simply because they can be set beside each other
unsupported_findings.source_anchor: that of Sandra George (1957-2013) is worth telling / it deserves to be seen far outside the city's confines / it's all eclipsed by his weird little paintings
unsupported_findings.why: The Form's no-centrality boundary surfaced as an asserted negative about the review's ranking -- which the source arguably contradicts.
unsupported_findings.min_correction: State the article's own selection without asserting what the review does not do.

unsupported_findings.span: It is stated as an obligation running two ways at once, and the second direction is the harder one.
unsupported_findings.source_anchor: a duty - to viewers and to their subjects - to tell them clearly
unsupported_findings.min_correction: Mark the comparison as the article's own reading.

unsupported_findings.span: Sadao Hasegawa's work, the review adds, stayed unpublished and unseen in his lifetime.
unsupported_findings.source_anchor: Most of the Japanese illustrator's work, you guessed it, stayed unpublished and unseen in his lifetime.
unsupported_findings.why: Source qualifier 'Most of' dropped and the absolute version attributed to the review. Reproduces FORM-1's original failure; Hasegawa was omitted from the packet but returned from the full source.

uncertain_findings.note: Possessive attribution of vocabulary to the festival -- weak ownership drift, immediately self-corrected by the next sentence ('The review reaches repeatedly for discovery'). Not gold-unsupported, but see CORRECTION note.

uncertain_findings.span: What it does not describe, and cannot
uncertain_findings.note: Certainty claim, downstream of GR2-04's dropped qualifier.

unsupported_findings.span: the visitor arrives at a name that was not in their possession an hour earlier
unsupported_findings.source_anchor: some subcultural genius or longlost creative you've never heard of
unsupported_findings.why: Same construction as G13-02 -- invented interval plus asserted knowledge-state.

unsupported_findings.span: And that second obligation is harder to discharge, because the subject is not in the room to say whether it has been met.
unsupported_findings.source_anchor: a duty - to viewers and to their subjects - to tell them clearly
unsupported_findings.why: Comparative plus causal explanation stated as settled, generalised to all subjects.
unsupported_findings.min_correction: Mark as the article's own reading.

unsupported_findings.source_anchor: (none -- the source never states when the festival takes place)
unsupported_findings.why: Month imported from world knowledge. WORLD-TRUE but SOURCE-UNSUPPORTED -- the architectural distinction.

corrections_to_prior_reporting: INTERPRETATION_AS_FACT is 3/3, not 2/3 -- FORM-1.3's 'the second side is the one that presses' is the same class and was not previously counted.

FORM_INSTRUCTION_AS_PROSE_CLAIM: FORM-1.3 P4 carries a milder variant ('not because the review ranks them or gathers them into a group'), judged defensible here because the source genuinely never ranks or groups these two against each other. R2's 'above the rest' is the unsupported one.

The structural regex used in the replicate task under-detects ownership drift: it did not match R2's 'the festival's characteristic verb'. The 0/0/0 festival-as-speaker result stands for explicit speaker/self-description claims, but is not a complete ownership check.

FROZEN_TOTALS.note: Frozen 2026-08-19 as the WG-1 authority. Adjudications are NOT to be changed during detector testing. The 10 UNSUPPORTED and 2 UNCERTAIN findings are itemised with exact spans; the remaining 83 SUPPORTED/INTERPRETATION propositions are recorded as counts. False positives are therefore scored as: any detector flag that does not correspond to one of the 12 itemised findings falls in the SUPPORTED/INTERPRETATION mass and is adjudicated case-by-case against the frozen source before being counted as FP.
